decisions.choice: a new law, continuing the rules for keeping the camp holy
decisions.reason: Chapter 5 dealt with people and wrongs that must be put right or removed from the camp. This speech turns to the opposite case: an ordinary Israelite who chooses to be set apart to the LORD for a time (verses 2-21). The chapter closes with the blessing the priests are to speak over the people (verses 22-27).

decisions.choice: passé simple for the narrative at Literal and Balanced ("parla", "dit"); passé composé at Readable ("a dit")
decisions.reason: As in the rest of Numbers: the passé simple is the tense of written French narrative, and Readable uses the passé composé of spoken and school French. The law of the Nazirite and the blessing use the future and the subjunctive of wishes at every level, with "devoir" or the imperative at Readable.

decisions.choice: Nazirite: one set apart
decisions.reason: The word comes from a verb meaning to separate or hold oneself apart, and it is related to the word for consecration in verse 7, which also names the gold plate on the high priest's turban (Exodus 29:6; Leviticus 8:9). For the time of the vow a Nazirite is set apart to the LORD by three signs: no wine or anything from the grapevine (verses 3-4), no razor on the head (verse 5), and no contact with the dead (verses 6-7). Samson and Samuel were set apart in this way from birth (Judges 13:5; 1 Samuel 1:11), and Amos 2:11-12 names Nazirites beside prophets.

decisions.choice: makes a special vow: a vow out of the ordinary
alternatives: separates himself to make a vow (reading the verb as another form of a verb meaning to set apart)
decisions.reason: The verb means to do something remarkable or beyond the usual, and with "to vow a vow" it marks a solemn and uncommon promise, as in Leviticus 27:2. A vow was a promise to give God something, here the vower's own life for a time.

decisions.choice: a man or a woman: the vow is open to both
decisions.reason: The law names both at the start. After that the Hebrew goes on with "he" and "his" through verse 21, as it does for any person; the rules apply to a woman who takes the vow just as to a man. Numbers 30:4-17 deals with vows made by women.

decisions.choice: they / the Nazirite
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "he" and "his" through this law. Balanced and Readable say "they" or "the Nazirite", since verse 2 makes clear that a woman may take the vow as well as a man.

decisions.choice: to become a Nazirite, a person set apart
decisions.reason: Readable explains the title with what it means; the meaning decision gives the background.

decisions.choice: "nazareo", "el voto de nazareato" (B); "apartarse"; in verses 3-21 the subject is left unsaid, or "esa persona" or "el nazareo" is named, and adjectives that would mark the sex are avoided where possible
decisions.reason: "Nazareo" is the established Spanish word for the title (m1), kept apart from "nazareno" (of Nazareth). The law is for a man or a woman (m3); Spanish can leave the subject in the verb, so it needs a noun only where the English names the person.

decisions.choice: "naziréen", "le vœu de naziréat" (B); "se séparer" (L), "être mis à part" (B, R); through verses 3-12 Balanced and Readable go on with "cette personne ... elle", and where the English names "the Nazirite", "le naziréen ... il"
decisions.reason: "Naziréen" is the established French word for the title (m1), and "naziréat" names the state. The English Balanced and Readable say "they" because the law is for a man or a woman (m3); French has no singular "they", so it goes on from "une personne" with "elle", as in Numbers 19, and uses the title "le naziréen", like "le prêtre", as a word for either sex where the English names the Nazirite. Literal keeps the Hebrew "il". A reviewer may prefer one form throughout.

decisions.choice: "nadhiri ya Mnadhiri"; "kujitenga" (L), "kutengwa" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Mnadhiri" (plural "Wanadhiri") is the usual Swahili word for the title and is built on "nadhiri" (vow), which shows what the title means (m1). The verb of separating is "kujitenga" at Literal and "kutengwa" (being set apart) at Balanced and Readable. Swahili verbs mark no gender, so the law reads for a man or a woman without help (m3).

source.text: מִיַּ֤יִן וְשֵׁכָר֙ יַזִּ֔יר חֹ֥מֶץ יַ֛יִן וְחֹ֥מֶץ שֵׁכָ֖ר לֹ֣א יִשְׁתֶּ֑ה וְכָל־מִשְׁרַ֤ת עֲנָבִים֙ לֹ֣א יִשְׁתֶּ֔ה וַעֲנָבִ֛ים לַחִ֥ים וִיבֵשִׁ֖ים לֹ֥א יֹאכֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: From wine and strong drink he shall separate [himself]; vinegar of wine and vinegar of strong drink he shall not drink, and any juice of grapes he shall not drink, and grapes fresh and dried he shall not eat.

en.L: from wine and strong drink he shall separate [himself]; vinegar of wine and vinegar of strong drink he shall not drink, and any juice of grapes he shall not drink, and grapes, fresh or dried, he shall not eat.
en.B: they are to keep away from wine and beer. They must not drink vinegar made from wine or from beer, and they must not drink any grape juice or eat grapes, whether fresh or dried.
en.R: They must not drink wine or beer, or even vinegar made from wine or beer. They must not drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins.

es.L: del vino y de la bebida fuerte se apartará; no beberá vinagre de vino ni vinagre de bebida fuerte, no beberá ningún jugo de uvas, y no comerá uvas frescas ni secas.

es.R: No debe beber vino ni cerveza, ni siquiera vinagre hecho de vino o de cerveza. No debe beber jugo de uva ni comer uvas ni pasas.

fr.L: il se séparera du vin et de la boisson forte ; il ne boira ni vinaigre de vin ni vinaigre de boisson forte, il ne boira aucun jus de raisin, et il ne mangera pas de raisins, frais ou secs.
fr.B: cette personne se tiendra à l’écart du vin et de la bière. Elle ne boira ni vinaigre de vin ni vinaigre de bière, elle ne boira aucun jus de raisin et ne mangera pas de raisins, ni frais ni secs.
fr.R: Elle ne doit pas boire de vin ni de bière, ni même de vinaigre fait avec du vin ou de la bière. Elle ne doit pas boire de jus de raisin ni manger de raisins frais ou secs.

sw.L: atajitenga na divai na kileo; hatakunywa siki ya divai wala siki ya kileo, wala hatakunywa maji yoyote ya zabibu, wala hatakula zabibu mbivu wala zilizokaushwa.

sw.R: Lazima asinywe divai wala pombe, wala hata siki iliyotengenezwa kwa divai au pombe. Lazima asinywe juisi ya zabibu wala kula zabibu au zabibu kavu.

decisions.choice: strong drink: an intoxicating drink, probably beer
decisions.reason: The word is from a verb meaning to become drunk. Beside wine it stands for any other alcoholic drink, most likely beer brewed from grain, perhaps also drinks fermented from dates or other fruit. Wine and strong drink together mean all that can make a person drunk, as in the rule for priests on duty (Leviticus 10:9).

decisions.choice: vinegar: wine or beer that has turned sour
decisions.reason: Sour wine was mixed with water as a common drink (Ruth 2:14). It is no longer intoxicating, yet the Nazirite may not drink it, because it still comes from wine or strong drink.

decisions.choice: the rule reaches every product of the vine, not only what makes a person drunk
decisions.reason: Grape juice, fresh grapes and raisins cannot make anyone drunk, but they are all forbidden. The Nazirite keeps away from the vine itself, as verse 4 says outright.

decisions.choice: beer
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "beer", the most likely sense, where Literal keeps the wider "strong drink". Readable says "raisins" for dried grapes.

en.B: As long as they remain set apart, they must not eat anything that comes from the grapevine, not even the seeds or the skins.
en.R: As long as the promise lasts, they must not eat anything that grows on a grapevine, not even the seeds or the skins.

es.L: Todos los días de su separación no comerá nada de lo que se hace de la vid del vino, desde las semillas hasta el hollejo.
es.B: Mientras dure su separación, no comerá nada que provenga de la vid, ni siquiera las semillas ni el hollejo.
es.R: Mientras dure su promesa, no debe comer nada que crezca en una vid, ni siquiera las semillas ni la piel de las uvas.

fr.L: Tous les jours de sa séparation, il ne mangera rien de ce qui est fait de la vigne du vin, depuis les pépins jusqu’à la peau.
fr.B: Aussi longtemps qu’elle restera mise à part, elle ne mangera rien de ce qui vient de la vigne, pas même les pépins ou la peau.
fr.R: Tant que dure sa promesse, elle ne doit rien manger de ce qui pousse sur la vigne, pas même les pépins ou la peau des raisins.

sw.L: Siku zote za kujitenga kwake, hatakula chochote kinachotengenezwa kutoka mzabibu wa divai, tangu mbegu hadi ganda.
sw.B: Muda wote atakaobaki ametengwa, hatakula chochote kinachotoka kwenye mzabibu, hata mbegu wala maganda.
sw.R: Wakati wote wa ahadi yake, lazima asile chochote kinachoota kwenye mzabibu, hata mbegu au maganda ya zabibu.

decisions.choice: seeds ... skin: the smallest parts of the grape
decisions.reason: Both words are found only here. They probably mean the seeds and the skins left after grapes are pressed; another reading takes them as unripe grapes and the husks. The point is the same either way: nothing at all from the vine, from one end to the other.

decisions.choice: all the days of his separation: the whole time of the vow
decisions.reason: The law does not fix how long the vow lasts. The person who vows sets the time ("the days that he separates himself", verse 5), and the rules hold for all of it.

decisions.choice: the vine of wine: the grapevine
decisions.reason: "The vine of wine" is the vine that grapes for wine grow on, as in Judges 13:14, where the same words describe what Samson's mother must not eat.

source.text: כָּל־יְמֵי֙ נֶ֣דֶר נִזְר֔וֹ תַּ֖עַר לֹא־יַעֲבֹ֣ר עַל־רֹאשׁ֑וֹ עַד־מְלֹ֨את הַיָּמִ֜ם אֲשֶׁר־יַזִּ֤יר לַיהוָה֙ קָדֹ֣שׁ יִהְיֶ֔ה גַּדֵּ֥ל פֶּ֖רַע שְׂעַ֥ר רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: All [the] days of [the] vow of his separation [a] razor shall not pass over his head; until [the] fulfilling of the days that he separates [himself] to Yahweh he shall be holy; [he shall] let grow [the] locks of [the] hair of his head.

en.L: All the days of the vow of his separation a razor shall not pass over his head; until the days are fulfilled that he separates [himself] to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, he shall be holy; he shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.
en.B: For the whole time of their vow of separation, no razor may touch their head. Until the time they have set apart for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is complete, they are holy, and they must let the hair of their head grow long.
en.R: During the whole time of the promise, they must not cut their hair. Until the time they set apart for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is over, they are holy. They must let their hair grow long.

es.L: Todos los días del voto de su separación no pasará navaja sobre su cabeza; hasta que se cumplan los días que se aparta para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, será santo; dejará crecer los mechones del cabello de su cabeza.
es.B: Durante todo el tiempo de su voto de separación, ninguna navaja tocará su cabeza. Hasta que se cumpla el tiempo que ha apartado para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, esa persona es santa, y dejará crecer libremente el cabello de su cabeza.
es.R: Durante todo el tiempo de su promesa, no debe cortarse el cabello. Hasta que termine el tiempo que apartó para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, esa persona es santa. Debe dejarse crecer el cabello.

fr.L: Tous les jours du vœu de sa séparation, le rasoir ne passera pas sur sa tête ; jusqu’à ce que soient accomplis les jours pendant lesquels il se sépare pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, il sera saint ; il laissera pousser les mèches des cheveux de sa tête.
fr.B: Pendant tout le temps de son vœu de séparation, aucun rasoir ne touchera sa tête. Jusqu’à la fin du temps qu’elle a mis à part pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, cette personne est sainte, et elle laissera pousser librement les cheveux de sa tête.
fr.R: Pendant toute la durée de sa promesse, elle ne doit pas se couper les cheveux. Jusqu’à la fin du temps qu’elle a mis à part pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, elle est sainte. Elle doit laisser pousser ses cheveux.

sw.L: Siku zote za nadhiri ya kujitenga kwake wembe hautapita juu ya kichwa chake; mpaka zitimie siku anazojitenga kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, atakuwa mtakatifu; ataziacha nywele za kichwa chake zikue ndefu.
sw.B: Muda wote wa nadhiri yake ya kutengwa, wembe usiguse kichwa chake. Mpaka muda alioutenga kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utimie, yeye ni mtakatifu, naye ataziacha nywele za kichwa chake zikue ndefu.
sw.R: Wakati wote wa ahadi yake, lazima asinyoe nywele zake. Mpaka muda alioutenga kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} uishe, yeye ni mtakatifu. Lazima aziache nywele zake zikue ndefu.

decisions.choice: no razor: the long hair is the visible sign of the vow
decisions.reason: Everyone could see a Nazirite's uncut hair. Verse 7 calls it "the consecration of his God on his head", and verses 9 and 18 speak of "the head of his consecration". Samson's strength was tied to this sign (Judges 13:5; 16:17), and Hannah promised that no razor would touch Samuel's head (1 Samuel 1:11).

decisions.choice: locks: hair that is loose and grows freely
decisions.reason: The noun comes from a verb meaning to let loose or leave unbound, used of hair in Leviticus 10:6 and 13:45. Here it is hair that is left to grow without cutting.

decisions.choice: holy: set apart as belonging to the LORD
decisions.reason: For the time of the vow an ordinary Israelite, man or woman, lives under rules close to those of the priests: no wine (Leviticus 10:9) and no contact with the dead (Leviticus 21:11). The holiness lasts until the days of the vow are complete.

source.text: כָּל־יְמֵ֥י הַזִּיר֖וֹ לַיהוָ֑ה עַל־נֶ֥פֶשׁ מֵ֖ת לֹ֥א יָבֹֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: All [the] days of his separating [himself] to Yahweh, to [a] person dead he shall not go.

en.L: All the days that he separates [himself] to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, he shall not go near a dead person.
en.B: Throughout the time they are set apart for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, they must not go near a dead body.
en.R: As long as they are set apart for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, they must not go near a dead body.

es.L: Todos los días que se aparte para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, no se acercará a una persona muerta.
es.B: Durante todo el tiempo de su separación para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, no se acercará a un cadáver.
es.R: Mientras dure su separación para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, no debe acercarse a un cadáver.

fr.L: Tous les jours où il se sépare pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, il n’ira pas auprès d’une personne morte.
fr.B: Pendant tout le temps où elle est mise à part pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, elle ne s’approchera pas d’un cadavre.
fr.R: Tant qu’elle est mise à part pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, elle ne doit pas s’approcher d’un mort.

sw.L: Siku zote anazojitenga kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hatakwenda karibu na mtu aliyekufa.
sw.B: Muda wote atakaokuwa ametengwa kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hatakaribia maiti.
sw.R: Muda wote akiwa ametengwa kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, lazima asikaribie maiti.

decisions.choice: a dead person: a corpse
decisions.reason: The word usually means a living being or person. With "dead" it means a dead person's body, as in Leviticus 21:11 and Numbers 19:11, 13.

decisions.choice: go near the dead: any contact that makes a person unclean
decisions.reason: Touching a dead body, or being in a tent where someone has died, made a person unclean for seven days (Numbers 19:11-16). Burying and mourning the dead was a normal family duty, but the Nazirite must keep away from it, as the high priest must (Leviticus 21:11).

source.text: לְאָבִ֣יו וּלְאִמּ֗וֹ לְאָחִיו֙ וּלְאַ֣חֹת֔וֹ לֹא־יִטַּמָּ֥א לָהֶ֖ם בְּמֹתָ֑ם כִּ֛י נֵ֥זֶר אֱלֹהָ֖יו עַל־רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: For his father and for his mother, for his brother and for his sister, he shall not make himself unclean for them when they die, for [the] consecration of his God [is] on his head.

en.L: For his father or for his mother, for his brother or for his sister, he shall not make himself unclean for them when they die, for the consecration of his God [is] on his head.
en.B: Even if their father or mother, brother or sister dies, they must not make themselves unclean for them, because the mark of their consecration to God is on their head.
en.R: Even when their own father or mother, brother or sister dies, they must not make themselves unclean. Their long hair is a sign that they belong to God.

es.L: Por su padre o por su madre, por su hermano o por su hermana, no se contaminará por ellos cuando mueran, porque la consagración de su Dios [está] sobre su cabeza.
es.B: Aunque muera su padre o su madre, su hermano o su hermana, no se contaminará por ellos, porque la señal de su consagración a Dios está sobre su cabeza.
es.R: Aunque muera su propio padre o su madre, su hermano o su hermana, no debe contaminarse. Su cabello largo es la señal de que pertenece a Dios.

fr.L: Pour son père ou pour sa mère, pour son frère ou pour sa sœur, il ne se rendra pas impur pour eux quand ils mourront, car la consécration de son Dieu [est] sur sa tête.
fr.B: Même si son père ou sa mère, son frère ou sa sœur meurt, elle ne se rendra pas impure pour eux, car le signe de sa consécration à Dieu est sur sa tête.
fr.R: Même quand son propre père ou sa mère, son frère ou sa sœur meurt, elle ne doit pas se rendre impure. Ses longs cheveux montrent qu’elle appartient à Dieu.

sw.L: Kwa ajili ya baba yake au kwa ajili ya mama yake, kwa ajili ya kaka yake au kwa ajili ya dada yake, hatajitia unajisi kwa ajili yao watakapokufa, kwa maana wakfu wa Mungu wake [u] juu ya kichwa chake.
sw.B: Hata baba yake au mama yake, kaka yake au dada yake akifa, hatajitia unajisi kwa ajili yao, kwa sababu alama ya kuwekwa kwake wakfu kwa Mungu iko kichwani pake.
sw.R: Hata baba yake mwenyewe au mama yake, kaka yake au dada yake akifa, lazima asijitie unajisi. Nywele zake ndefu ni ishara kwamba yeye ni mali ya Mungu.

decisions.choice: consecration: being set apart, and the sign of it
decisions.reason: The word means separation or consecration, and also the visible sign of it. It names the gold plate on the high priest's turban, "the holy crown" (Exodus 29:6; Leviticus 8:9). Leviticus 21:12 gives the high priest a reason in almost the same words: "the consecration of the anointing oil of his God is on him". Here the sign is the Nazirite's uncut hair.

decisions.choice: not even for the closest family
decisions.reason: Ordinary priests could become unclean to bury a father, mother, son, daughter, brother or unmarried sister (Leviticus 21:1-3). The high priest could not, even for father or mother (Leviticus 21:11). The Nazirite is held to the high priest's rule for the time of the vow.

decisions.choice: the mark of their consecration / their long hair is a sign
decisions.reason: Balanced says what the "consecration" on the head is: a mark or sign. Readable names it as the long hair, as verses 5, 9 and 18 make plain.

decisions.choice: "la consécration" for this word (verses 7, 9, 18, 19), "la séparation" where the English says "separation"
decisions.reason: The one Hebrew word is both the state of being set apart and its sign (m1). French follows the English Literal: "séparation" for the time of the vow, "consécration" where the sign on the head is meant ("sa tête consacrée"). Balanced names the sign ("le signe de sa consécration").

decisions.choice: "wakfu", "kichwa kilichowekwa wakfu" for the consecration and the consecrated head; "kujitenga" / "kutengwa" for separation
decisions.reason: "Kuweka wakfu" is to set something apart for God, and "wakfu" can name what is so set apart, which suits the sign on the head (m1). "Kutakasa" is kept for the verb "consecrate" in verse 11, as in Leviticus.

source.text: כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י נִזְר֑וֹ קָדֹ֥שׁ ה֖וּא לַֽיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: All [the] days of his separation holy [is] he to Yahweh.

en.L: All the days of his separation he [is] holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: For the whole time of their separation they are holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: All through that time, the Nazirite is holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Todos los días de su separación, santo [es] él para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Durante todo el tiempo de su separación, esa persona es santa para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Durante todo ese tiempo, el nazareo es santo para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Tous les jours de sa séparation, il [est] saint pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Pendant tout le temps de sa séparation, cette personne est sainte pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Pendant tout ce temps, le naziréen est saint pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Siku zote za kujitenga kwake, yeye [ni] mtakatifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Muda wote wa kutengwa kwake, yeye ni mtakatifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Wakati wote huo, Mnadhiri ni mtakatifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: holy to the LORD: belonging to him in a special way
decisions.reason: This sums up verses 3-7. The three rules are not ends in themselves; they show that the person now belongs to the LORD for the time of the vow.

source.text: וְכִֽי־יָמ֨וּת מֵ֤ת עָלָיו֙ בְּפֶ֣תַע פִּתְאֹ֔ם וְטִמֵּ֖א רֹ֣אשׁ נִזְר֑וֹ וְגִלַּ֤ח רֹאשׁוֹ֙ בְּי֣וֹם טָהֳרָת֔וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י יְגַלְּחֶֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And if dies [a] dying [one] beside him in suddenness suddenly, and he defiles [the] head of his consecration, then he shall shave his head on [the] day of his cleansing; on the day the seventh he shall shave it.

en.L: And if anyone dies beside him very suddenly, and he makes his consecrated head unclean, then he shall shave his head on the day of his cleansing; on the seventh day he shall shave it.
en.B: If someone dies very suddenly beside them, and so their consecrated head becomes unclean, they must shave their head on the day of their cleansing. On the seventh day they must shave it.
en.R: Someone might die suddenly right next to a Nazirite. Then the Nazirite's long hair, the sign of the promise, becomes unclean. Seven days later, on the day they are made clean, they must shave their head.

es.L: Y si alguien muere junto a él muy repentinamente, y contamina su cabeza consagrada, entonces rapará su cabeza el día de su purificación; al séptimo día la rapará.
es.B: Si alguien muere de repente a su lado, y así su cabeza consagrada queda impura, se rapará la cabeza el día de su purificación. Al séptimo día se la rapará.
es.R: Puede ser que alguien muera de repente junto a un nazareo. Entonces su cabello largo, la señal de su promesa, queda impuro. Siete días después, el día en que se purifica, tiene que raparse la cabeza.

fr.L: Et si quelqu’un meurt auprès de lui très soudainement, et qu’il rend impure sa tête consacrée, il rasera sa tête le jour de sa purification ; le septième jour il la rasera.
fr.B: Si quelqu’un meurt subitement à côté d’elle, et que sa tête consacrée devient ainsi impure, elle se rasera la tête le jour de sa purification. C’est le septième jour qu’elle se la rasera.
fr.R: Il peut arriver que quelqu’un meure tout à coup juste à côté d’un naziréen. Alors ses longs cheveux, signe de sa promesse, deviennent impurs. Sept jours plus tard, le jour où il est purifié, il doit se raser la tête.

sw.L: Na mtu akifa karibu naye ghafla kwa kushtukiza, naye akakitia unajisi kichwa chake kilichowekwa wakfu, atanyoa kichwa chake siku ya kutakaswa kwake; siku ya saba atakinyoa.
sw.B: Mtu akifa ghafla kabisa kando yake, na hivyo kichwa chake kilichowekwa wakfu kikatiwa unajisi, atanyoa kichwa chake siku ya kutakaswa kwake. Siku ya saba atakinyoa.
sw.R: Huenda mtu akafa ghafla karibu kabisa na Mnadhiri. Hapo nywele zake ndefu, ishara ya ahadi yake, zinakuwa najisi. Siku saba baadaye, siku anapotakaswa, lazima anyoe kichwa chake.

decisions.choice: in suddenness suddenly: without any warning
decisions.reason: Two words for suddenness are put together to stress that the death could not be foreseen or avoided. The law has in view an accident, not a choice to break the vow.

decisions.choice: the head of his consecration: the hair grown under the vow
decisions.reason: The consecrated head is the uncut hair that marks the vow (verse 7). Once it has become unclean it cannot be kept, and it is shaved off.

decisions.choice: the day of his cleansing, the seventh day
decisions.reason: Uncleanness from a dead body lasted seven days. The person was sprinkled with the water for cleansing on the third and seventh days and became clean on the seventh (Numbers 19:11-12, 19).

decisions.choice: Seven days later
decisions.reason: Readable puts the seventh day as a time after the death, which is how the days of uncleanness are counted in Numbers 19:11.

source.text: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י יָבִא֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים א֥וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֑ה אֶל־הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And on the day the eighth he shall bring two turtledoves or two young [ones] of [a] dove to the priest, to [the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting.

en.L: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the entrance of the tent of meeting.
en.B: On the eighth day they must bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
en.R: On the eighth day they must bring two doves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance of the meeting tent.

es.L: Y el octavo día traerá dos tórtolas o dos pichones al sacerdote, a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.B: El octavo día llevará dos tórtolas o dos pichones al sacerdote, a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.R: El octavo día tiene que llevarle al sacerdote dos palomas o dos pichones, a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro.

fr.L: Et le huitième jour, il apportera deux tourterelles ou deux jeunes pigeons au prêtre, à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.B: Le huitième jour, elle apportera deux tourterelles ou deux jeunes pigeons au prêtre, à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.R: Le huitième jour, il doit apporter au prêtre deux colombes ou deux jeunes pigeons, à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre.

sw.L: Na siku ya nane ataleta hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa kwa kuhani, kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania.
sw.B: Siku ya nane ataleta hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa kwa kuhani, kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania.
sw.R: Siku ya nane lazima alete kwa kuhani njiwa wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa, kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania.

decisions.choice: two birds: the smallest of the animal offerings
decisions.reason: Birds were the least costly sacrifice. The same pair is brought by a poor person who cannot afford a lamb (Leviticus 5:7; 12:8), and by someone cleansed from a bodily discharge (Leviticus 15:14, 29).

decisions.choice: sons of a dove: young pigeons
decisions.reason: "Sons of" a bird means its young.

decisions.choice: doves
decisions.reason: Readable says "doves" for turtledoves, as Leviticus 5:7 does at that level.

source.text: וְעָשָׂ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן אֶחָ֤ד לְחַטָּאת֙ וְאֶחָ֣ד לְעֹלָ֔ה וְכִפֶּ֣ר עָלָ֔יו מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖א עַל־הַנָּ֑פֶשׁ וְקִדַּ֥שׁ אֶת־רֹאשׁ֖וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: And will offer the priest one as [a] sin offering and one as [a] burnt offering, and he will make atonement for him, because he sinned by the person; and he shall consecrate his head on that day.

en.L: And the priest shall offer one as a sin offering and one as a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because he sinned by reason of the dead person; and he shall consecrate his head on that same day.
en.B: The priest is to offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, and so make atonement for them, because they sinned through the dead body. That same day they must consecrate their head again.
en.R: The priest must offer one bird as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering. In this way he will make atonement for the Nazirite, who did wrong by coming near a dead body. That same day the Nazirite must set apart their head to God again.

es.L: Y el sacerdote ofrecerá uno como sacrificio por el pecado y otro como holocausto, y hará expiación por él, porque pecó a causa del muerto; y consagrará su cabeza aquel mismo día.
es.B: El sacerdote ofrecerá uno como sacrificio por el pecado y el otro como holocausto, y así hará expiación por esa persona, porque pecó a causa del cadáver. Ese mismo día volverá a consagrar su cabeza.
es.R: El sacerdote tiene que ofrecer un ave como sacrificio por el pecado y la otra como holocausto. Así hará expiación por el nazareo, que cometió una falta al acercarse a un cadáver. Ese mismo día, el nazareo tiene que apartar de nuevo su cabeza para Dios.

fr.L: Et le prêtre offrira l’un en sacrifice pour le péché et l’autre en holocauste, et il fera l’expiation pour lui, parce qu’il a péché à cause du mort ; et il consacrera sa tête ce jour-là.
fr.B: Le prêtre offrira l’un en sacrifice pour le péché et l’autre en holocauste, et fera ainsi l’expiation pour cette personne, parce qu’elle a péché à cause du cadavre. Le jour même, elle consacrera de nouveau sa tête.
fr.R: Le prêtre doit offrir un oiseau en sacrifice pour le péché et l’autre en holocauste. Ainsi, il fera l’expiation pour le naziréen, qui a commis une faute en s’approchant d’un mort. Le jour même, le naziréen doit de nouveau mettre sa tête à part pour Dieu.

sw.L: Na kuhani atamtoa mmoja kuwa sadaka ya dhambi na mmoja kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na atamfanyia upatanisho, kwa sababu alitenda dhambi kwa ajili ya maiti; naye atakitakasa kichwa chake siku hiyo hiyo.
sw.B: Kuhani atamtoa mmoja kuwa sadaka ya dhambi na mwingine kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na hivyo kumfanyia upatanisho, kwa sababu alitenda dhambi kwa sababu ya maiti. Siku hiyo hiyo atakitakasa tena kichwa chake.
sw.R: Lazima kuhani amtoe ndege mmoja kuwa sadaka ya dhambi na mwingine kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa. Kwa njia hiyo atamfanyia upatanisho Mnadhiri, aliyekosa kwa kukaribia maiti. Siku hiyo hiyo, lazima Mnadhiri akitenge tena kichwa chake kwa ajili ya Mungu.

decisions.choice: he sinned by the dead body: he fell short of the vow
decisions.reason: The verb is the ordinary word for sin, but verse 9 makes clear the death came without warning. What needs atonement is not a deliberate wrong but the breach of holiness the vow required: the sin offering cleanses the person, as it does after other kinds of uncleanness (Leviticus 12:6-8; 15:14-15).

decisions.choice: sin offering and burnt offering
decisions.reason: The sin offering deals with what has made the person unclean or guilty; the burnt offering, burned whole, is a gift to the LORD (Leviticus 1:3-9; 4:27-31). With birds, the same pair appears in Leviticus 5:7-10.

decisions.choice: he shall consecrate his head: the Nazirite begins the vow again
alternatives: the priest shall consecrate his head
decisions.reason: "He" here is most naturally the Nazirite, who sets his head apart once more and starts to grow his hair afresh, as verse 12 goes on to say. Grammar alone would allow the priest as the subject.

decisions.choice: who did wrong by coming near a dead body
decisions.reason: Readable says what the sin was, from verses 6 and 9: being near a dead person.

source.text: וְהִזִּ֤יר לַֽיהוָה֙ אֶת־יְמֵ֣י נִזְר֔וֹ וְהֵבִ֛יא כֶּ֥בֶשׂ בֶּן־שְׁנָת֖וֹ לְאָשָׁ֑ם וְהַיָּמִ֤ים הָרִאשֹׁנִים֙ יִפְּל֔וּ כִּ֥י טָמֵ֖א נִזְרֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he shall separate to Yahweh [the] days of his separation, and bring [a] lamb, [a] son of its year, as [a] guilt offering; and the days the former shall fall, because was defiled his separation.

en.L: And he shall separate to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the days of his separation, and bring a male lamb a year old as a guilt offering; and the former days shall fall [away], because his separation was made unclean.
en.B: They must dedicate to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the days of their separation once more and bring a year-old male lamb as a guilt offering. The earlier days do not count, because their separation was made unclean.
en.R: They must start their promise to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} over again and bring a male lamb one year old as a guilt offering. The days they already kept do not count, because their time of being set apart was made unclean.

es.L: Y apartará para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} los días de su separación, y traerá un cordero de un año como sacrificio por la culpa; y los días anteriores caerán, porque su separación fue contaminada.
es.B: Volverá a dedicar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} los días de su separación y traerá un cordero macho de un año como sacrificio por la culpa. Los días anteriores no cuentan, porque su separación quedó contaminada.
es.R: El nazareo tiene que empezar de nuevo la promesa hecha {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y traer un cordero macho de un año como sacrificio por la culpa. Los días que ya cumplió no cuentan, porque su tiempo de separación quedó impuro.

fr.L: Et il séparera pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les jours de sa séparation, et il apportera un agneau mâle d’un an en sacrifice de réparation ; et les jours précédents tomberont, car sa séparation a été rendue impure.
fr.B: Elle consacrera de nouveau {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} les jours de sa séparation et apportera un agneau mâle d’un an en sacrifice de réparation. Les jours précédents ne comptent pas, car sa séparation a été rendue impure.
fr.R: Le naziréen doit recommencer la promesse faite {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} et apporter un agneau mâle d’un an en sacrifice de réparation. Les jours qu’il a déjà passés ne comptent pas, car son temps de mise à part a été rendu impur.

sw.L: Naye atajitenga kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} siku za kujitenga kwake, na kuleta mwana-kondoo dume wa mwaka mmoja kuwa sadaka ya hatia; na siku za kwanza zitaanguka, kwa sababu kujitenga kwake kulitiwa unajisi.
sw.B: Atamtengea tena {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} siku za kutengwa kwake na kuleta mwana-kondoo dume wa mwaka mmoja kuwa sadaka ya hatia. Siku za mwanzo hazitahesabiwa, kwa sababu kutengwa kwake kulitiwa unajisi.
sw.R: Lazima aanze upya ahadi yake kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kuleta mwana-kondoo dume wa mwaka mmoja kuwa sadaka ya hatia. Siku alizokwisha kutimiza hazihesabiwi, kwa sababu muda wake wa kutengwa ulitiwa unajisi.

decisions.choice: the former days shall fall: they are lost
decisions.reason: Days that "fall" drop out of the count. The time already kept does not count toward the vow, and the full period must be kept again from the start.

decisions.choice: guilt offering: payment for wrong done to something holy
decisions.reason: The guilt offering was brought when something that belonged to the LORD had been wronged or lost (Leviticus 5:14-16). Here the holy time the Nazirite had promised to the LORD was spoiled, and the lamb makes up for it.

decisions.choice: he shall separate the days: he dedicates a new period of the vow
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of taking the vow in verses 2 and 5. The Nazirite takes the vow on himself again for the full time.

decisions.choice: once more / over again
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say outright that the vow starts again, which the second half of the verse makes clear.

source.text: וְזֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַנָּזִ֑יר בְּי֗וֹם מְלֹאת֙ יְמֵ֣י נִזְר֔וֹ יָבִ֣יא אֹת֔וֹ אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And this [is the] law of the Nazirite: on [the] day of [the] fulfilling of [the] days of his separation, one shall bring him to [the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting.

en.L: And this [is] the law of the Nazirite: on the day the days of his separation are fulfilled, one shall bring him to the entrance of the tent of meeting.
en.B: This is the instruction for the Nazirite when the time of their separation is complete: they are to be brought to the entrance of the tent of meeting.
en.R: Here are the rules for the day when the Nazirite's promise is over. They must be brought to the entrance of the meeting tent.

es.L: Y esta [es] la ley del nazareo: el día en que se cumplan los días de su separación, se le traerá a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.B: Estas son las instrucciones para el nazareo cuando se cumpla el tiempo de su separación: se le llevará a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.R: Estas son las normas para el día en que termina la promesa del nazareo. Hay que llevarlo a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro.

fr.L: Et voici la loi du naziréen : le jour où seront accomplis les jours de sa séparation, on le fera venir à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.B: Voici les instructions pour le naziréen, quand le temps de sa séparation sera achevé : on le fera venir à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.R: Voici les règles pour le jour où la promesse du naziréen prend fin. On doit l’amener à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre.

sw.L: Na hii [ndiyo] sheria ya Mnadhiri: siku zitakapotimia siku za kujitenga kwake, ataletwa kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania.
sw.B: Haya ndiyo maelekezo kwa Mnadhiri muda wa kutengwa kwake utakapotimia: ataletwa kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania.
sw.R: Hizi ndizo taratibu za siku ambayo ahadi ya Mnadhiri inaisha. Lazima aletwe kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania.

decisions.choice: one shall bring him: he is to be brought
alternatives: he shall come to the entrance
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "he shall bring him" with no one named as the subject. It is most simply an impersonal "one shall bring him", that is, the Nazirite is to be brought. Others read it as "he shall bring himself" (he shall come), or take "it" as the offering that verse 14 goes on to list. All three end with the Nazirite and the offering at the sanctuary.

decisions.choice: law: instruction for a particular case
decisions.reason: The word means teaching or instruction. Here, as in Leviticus 7:11, it names the set procedure for one kind of case, which runs to verse 20 and is summed up in verse 21.

decisions.choice: instruction / rules
decisions.reason: Literal says "law". Balanced says "instruction" and Readable "rules", as Leviticus 7:11 does, since the word names a procedure rather than a law code.

source.text: וְהִקְרִ֣יב אֶת־קָרְבָּנ֣וֹ לַיהוָ֡ה כֶּבֶשׂ֩ בֶּן־שְׁנָת֨וֹ תָמִ֤ים אֶחָד֙ לְעֹלָ֔ה וְכַבְשָׂ֨ה אַחַ֧ת בַּת־שְׁנָתָ֛הּ תְּמִימָ֖ה לְחַטָּ֑את וְאַֽיִל־אֶחָ֥ד תָּמִ֖ים לִשְׁלָמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he shall bring near his offering to Yahweh: [a] lamb, [a] son of its year, unblemished, one, as [a] burnt offering, and [a] ewe lamb, one, [a] daughter of its year, unblemished, as [a] sin offering, and [a] ram, one, unblemished, as peace offerings,

en.L: And he shall bring near his offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: one male lamb a year old, unblemished, as a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb a year old, unblemished, as a sin offering, and one ram, unblemished, as a peace offering,
en.B: There they are to present their offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: a year-old male lamb without defect for a burnt offering, a year-old ewe lamb without defect for a sin offering, a ram without defect for a peace offering,
en.R: There they must bring their offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: a male lamb one year old for a burnt offering, a female lamb one year old for a sin offering, and a ram for a peace offering. Each animal must be perfect, with nothing wrong with it.

es.L: Y presentará su ofrenda {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: un cordero de un año, sin defecto, como holocausto, y una cordera de un año, sin defecto, como sacrificio por el pecado, y un carnero sin defecto como sacrificio de paz,
es.B: Allí presentará su ofrenda {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: un cordero de un año sin defecto para el holocausto, una cordera de un año sin defecto para el sacrificio por el pecado, un carnero sin defecto para el sacrificio de paz,
es.R: Allí tiene que traer su ofrenda {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: un cordero macho de un año para un holocausto, una cordera de un año para un sacrificio por el pecado, y un carnero para un sacrificio de paz. Cada animal tiene que ser perfecto, que no tenga nada malo.

fr.L: Et il présentera son offrande {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : un agneau mâle d’un an, sans défaut, en holocauste, et une agnelle d’un an, sans défaut, en sacrifice pour le péché, et un bélier sans défaut en sacrifice de communion,
fr.B: Là, il présentera son offrande {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : un agneau mâle d’un an sans défaut pour l’holocauste, une agnelle d’un an sans défaut pour le sacrifice pour le péché, un bélier sans défaut pour le sacrifice de communion,
fr.R: Là, il doit apporter son offrande {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : un agneau mâle d’un an pour un holocauste, une agnelle d’un an pour un sacrifice pour le péché, et un bélier pour un sacrifice de communion. Chaque animal doit être parfait, sans aucun défaut.

sw.L: Naye atamtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka yake: mwana-kondoo dume mmoja wa mwaka mmoja, asiye na kasoro, kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na mwana-kondoo jike mmoja wa mwaka mmoja, asiye na kasoro, kuwa sadaka ya dhambi, na kondoo dume mmoja asiye na kasoro kuwa sadaka ya amani,
sw.B: Huko atamtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka yake: mwana-kondoo dume wa mwaka mmoja asiye na kasoro kwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa, mwana-kondoo jike wa mwaka mmoja asiye na kasoro kwa sadaka ya dhambi, kondoo dume asiye na kasoro kwa sadaka ya amani,
sw.R: Huko lazima amletee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka yake: mwana-kondoo dume wa mwaka mmoja kwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa, mwana-kondoo jike wa mwaka mmoja kwa sadaka ya dhambi, na kondoo dume kwa sadaka ya amani. Kila mnyama lazima awe mkamilifu, asiye na tatizo lolote.

decisions.choice: burnt offering, sin offering, peace offering: all the main kinds
decisions.reason: The two birds of verse 10 dealt with uncleanness. The completed vow is marked with all the main animal sacrifices together: a gift burned whole, an offering of cleansing, and a peace offering shared as a meal, with grain and drink offerings (verse 15).

decisions.choice: unblemished: whole, with no defect
decisions.reason: An animal offered to the LORD had to be sound, with no injury, disease or deformity (Leviticus 22:19-22).

decisions.choice: Each animal must be perfect
decisions.reason: Readable says once at the end what the Hebrew says of each animal.

source.text: וְסַ֣ל מַצּ֗וֹת סֹ֤לֶת חַלֹּת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן וּרְקִיקֵ֥י מַצּ֖וֹת מְשֻׁחִ֣ים בַּשָּׁ֑מֶן וּמִנְחָתָ֖ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: and [a] basket of unleavened bread, fine flour, cakes mixed with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread smeared with oil, and their grain offering and their drink offerings.

en.L: and a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers smeared with oil, and their grain offering and their drink offerings.
en.B: and a basket of bread made without yeast, loaves of fine flour mixed with oil and wafers spread with oil, together with the grain offerings and drink offerings that go with them.
en.R: They must also bring a basket of bread made without yeast. It must have thick loaves of fine flour mixed with oil and thin wafers brushed with oil. They must bring the grain offerings and drink offerings that go with the animals too.

es.L: y un canastillo de panes sin levadura, tortas de flor de harina amasadas con aceite, y obleas sin levadura untadas con aceite, y su ofrenda de cereal y sus libaciones.
es.B: y un canastillo de panes sin levadura, tortas de flor de harina amasadas con aceite y obleas untadas con aceite, junto con las ofrendas de cereal y las libaciones que los acompañan.
es.R: También tiene que traer un canastillo de pan hecho sin levadura. Debe tener panes gruesos de la mejor harina mezclada con aceite y obleas delgadas untadas con aceite. Tiene que traer también las ofrendas de cereal y las ofrendas de vino que acompañan a los animales.

fr.L: et une corbeille de pains sans levain, des gâteaux de fleur de farine pétris à l’huile, et des galettes sans levain enduites d’huile, ainsi que leur offrande végétale et leurs libations.
fr.B: ainsi qu’une corbeille de pains sans levain, des gâteaux de fleur de farine pétris à l’huile et des galettes enduites d’huile, avec les offrandes végétales et les libations qui les accompagnent.
fr.R: Il doit aussi apporter une corbeille de pains faits sans levain. Elle doit contenir des pains épais de la meilleure farine mêlée d’huile, et des galettes minces badigeonnées d’huile. Il doit apporter aussi les offrandes végétales et les offrandes de vin qui accompagnent les animaux.

sw.L: na kikapu cha mikate isiyotiwa chachu, mikate ya unga laini iliyochanganywa na mafuta, na mikate myembamba isiyotiwa chachu iliyopakwa mafuta, pamoja na sadaka yao ya nafaka na sadaka zao za kinywaji.
sw.B: na kikapu cha mikate isiyotiwa chachu, mikate ya unga laini iliyochanganywa na mafuta na mikate myembamba iliyopakwa mafuta, pamoja na sadaka za nafaka na sadaka za kinywaji zinazoambatana nazo.
sw.R: Lazima pia alete kikapu cha mikate isiyotiwa chachu. Kiwe na mikate minene ya unga bora kabisa uliochanganywa na mafuta, na mikate myembamba iliyopakwa mafuta. Lazima pia alete sadaka za nafaka na sadaka za kinywaji zinazoambatana na wanyama hao.

decisions.choice: their grain offering and their drink offerings: those that belong with the animals
decisions.reason: "Their" refers to the animal offerings of verse 14. Each animal sacrifice came with its own measure of flour, oil and wine, set out in Numbers 15:1-12.

decisions.choice: drink offering: wine poured out at the altar
decisions.reason: The drink offering was wine poured out to the LORD with a sacrifice (Numbers 15:5, 7; 28:7).

decisions.choice: cakes and wafers: thick and thin bread
decisions.reason: The cakes were thick round loaves; the wafers were thin. The same breads come with the peace offering of thanksgiving (Leviticus 7:12).

decisions.choice: that go with them / that go with the animals
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say whose grain and drink offerings these are.

source.text: וְהִקְרִ֥יב הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְעָשָׂ֥ה אֶת־חַטָּאת֖וֹ וְאֶת־עֹלָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And will bring near the priest before Yahweh and will offer his sin offering and his burnt offering.

en.L: And the priest shall bring [them] near before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and offer his sin offering and his burnt offering.
en.B: The priest is to present them before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and offer the Nazirite's sin offering and burnt offering.
en.R: The priest must bring them to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He must offer the sin offering first and then the burnt offering.

es.L: Y el sacerdote [los] presentará delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y ofrecerá su sacrificio por el pecado y su holocausto.
es.B: El sacerdote los presentará delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y ofrecerá el sacrificio por el pecado y el holocausto del nazareo.
es.R: El sacerdote tiene que llevarlos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Tiene que ofrecer primero el sacrificio por el pecado y después el holocausto.

fr.L: Et le prêtre [les] présentera devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et offrira son sacrifice pour le péché et son holocauste.
fr.B: Le prêtre les présentera devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et offrira le sacrifice pour le péché et l’holocauste du naziréen.
fr.R: Le prêtre doit les apporter {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Il doit offrir d’abord le sacrifice pour le péché, puis l’holocauste.

sw.L: Na kuhani atavileta karibu mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na kutoa sadaka yake ya dhambi na sadaka yake ya kuteketezwa.
sw.B: Kuhani atavileta mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kutoa sadaka ya dhambi na sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya Mnadhiri.
sw.R: Lazima kuhani avilete kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Lazima atoe kwanza sadaka ya dhambi, kisha sadaka ya kuteketezwa.

decisions.choice: sin offering, then burnt offering
decisions.reason: The order of offering is not the order of the list in verse 14. As in Leviticus 5:8-10, the sin offering comes first to cleanse, and then the burnt offering is given.

decisions.choice: the Nazirite's
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "his"; Balanced names the Nazirite so that it is not read as the priest's own offering.

decisions.choice: first ... and then
decisions.reason: Readable makes the order plain.

source.text: וְאֶת־הָאַ֜יִל יַעֲשֶׂ֨ה זֶ֤בַח שְׁלָמִים֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה עַ֖ל סַ֣ל הַמַּצּ֑וֹת וְעָשָׂה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶת־מִנְחָת֖וֹ וְאֶת־נִסְכּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And the ram he shall offer [as a] sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh, with [the] basket of the unleavened bread; and shall offer the priest its grain offering and its drink offering.

en.L: And the ram he shall offer as a sacrifice of peace offerings to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, with the basket of unleavened bread; and the priest shall offer its grain offering and its drink offering.
en.B: The ram is to be offered to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as a peace offering, together with the basket of bread made without yeast, and the priest is also to present its grain offering and drink offering.
en.R: Then the priest must offer the ram as a peace offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, along with the basket of bread made without yeast. He must also offer the grain offering and drink offering that go with it.

es.L: Y el carnero lo ofrecerá como sacrificio de paz {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, con el canastillo de los panes sin levadura; y el sacerdote ofrecerá su ofrenda de cereal y su libación.
es.B: El carnero será ofrecido {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} como sacrificio de paz, junto con el canastillo de panes sin levadura, y el sacerdote presentará también la ofrenda de cereal y la libación que lo acompañan.
es.R: Luego el sacerdote tiene que ofrecer el carnero {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} como sacrificio de paz, junto con el canastillo de pan sin levadura. También tiene que ofrecer la ofrenda de cereal y la ofrenda de vino que lo acompañan.

fr.L: Et le bélier, il l’offrira en sacrifice de communion {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, avec la corbeille de pains sans levain ; et le prêtre offrira son offrande végétale et sa libation.
fr.B: Le bélier sera offert {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} en sacrifice de communion, avec la corbeille de pains sans levain, et le prêtre présentera aussi l’offrande végétale et la libation qui l’accompagnent.
fr.R: Ensuite, le prêtre doit offrir le bélier {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} en sacrifice de communion, avec la corbeille de pains sans levain. Il doit aussi offrir l’offrande végétale et l’offrande de vin qui l’accompagnent.

sw.L: Na kondoo dume atamtoa kuwa dhabihu ya sadaka za amani kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, pamoja na kikapu cha mikate isiyotiwa chachu; na kuhani atatoa sadaka yake ya nafaka na sadaka yake ya kinywaji.
sw.B: Kondoo dume atatolewa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuwa sadaka ya amani, pamoja na kikapu cha mikate isiyotiwa chachu, na kuhani atatoa pia sadaka yake ya nafaka na sadaka yake ya kinywaji.
sw.R: Kisha lazima kuhani amtoe kondoo dume kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuwa sadaka ya amani, pamoja na kikapu cha mikate isiyotiwa chachu. Lazima pia atoe sadaka ya nafaka na sadaka ya kinywaji zinazoambatana naye.

decisions.choice: sacrifice of peace offerings: a sacrifice shared as a meal
decisions.reason: In a peace offering the fat was burned on the altar, the priest received set portions, and the worshiper ate the rest with family and friends (Leviticus 3; 7:11-18, 28-34). Verses 19-20 give the priest's portions.

decisions.choice: The ram is to be offered
decisions.reason: Balanced puts the sentence in the passive so that the priest, named only in the second half, is not mistaken for someone else.

source.text: וְגִלַּ֣ח הַנָּזִ֗יר פֶּ֛תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד אֶת־רֹ֣אשׁ נִזְר֑וֹ וְלָקַ֗ח אֶת־שְׂעַר֙ רֹ֣אשׁ נִזְר֔וֹ וְנָתַן֙ עַל־הָאֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁר־תַּ֖חַת זֶ֥בַח הַשְּׁלָמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And will shave the Nazirite [at the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting [the] head of his consecration, and take [the] hair of [the] head of his consecration and put [it] on the fire that [is] under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.

en.L: And the Nazirite shall shave his consecrated head at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and take the hair of his consecrated head and put [it] on the fire that [is] under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.
en.B: Then at the entrance of the tent of meeting the Nazirite is to shave their consecrated head, take the hair, and put it on the fire under the peace offering.
en.R: Then, at the entrance of the meeting tent, the Nazirite must shave off the long hair that showed they belonged to God. They must put the hair on the fire that is burning under the peace offering.

es.L: Y el nazareo rapará su cabeza consagrada a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro, y tomará el cabello de su cabeza consagrada y [lo] pondrá sobre el fuego que [está] debajo del sacrificio de paz.
es.B: Luego, a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro, el nazareo se rapará la cabeza consagrada, tomará el cabello y lo pondrá en el fuego que arde bajo el sacrificio de paz.
es.R: Luego, a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro, el nazareo tiene que raparse el cabello largo que mostraba que pertenecía a Dios. Tiene que poner ese cabello en el fuego que arde debajo del sacrificio de paz.

fr.L: Et le naziréen rasera sa tête consacrée à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre, et il prendra les cheveux de sa tête consacrée et [les] mettra sur le feu qui [est] sous le sacrifice de communion.
fr.B: Puis, à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre, le naziréen rasera sa tête consacrée, prendra les cheveux et les mettra sur le feu qui brûle sous le sacrifice de communion.
fr.R: Ensuite, à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre, le naziréen doit raser ses longs cheveux, qui montraient qu’il appartenait à Dieu. Il doit mettre ces cheveux sur le feu qui brûle sous le sacrifice de communion.

sw.L: Na Mnadhiri atanyoa kichwa chake kilichowekwa wakfu kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania, na kuchukua nywele za kichwa chake kilichowekwa wakfu na kuziweka juu ya moto ulio chini ya dhabihu ya sadaka za amani.
sw.B: Kisha kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania Mnadhiri atanyoa kichwa chake kilichowekwa wakfu, achukue nywele hizo, na kuziweka juu ya moto ulio chini ya sadaka ya amani.
sw.R: Kisha, kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania, lazima Mnadhiri anyoe nywele ndefu zilizoonyesha kwamba yeye ni mali ya Mungu. Lazima aziweke nywele hizo juu ya moto unaowaka chini ya sadaka ya amani.

decisions.choice: the hair goes on the altar fire
decisions.reason: The hair had grown as a holy thing, the sign of the vow (verse 7). It is not kept or thrown away; it is burned with the peace offering, as holy things given to the LORD are.

decisions.choice: at the entrance of the tent of meeting: in public, at the sanctuary
decisions.reason: The vow ends where the offerings are made, before the priest and anyone present, as the vow itself was a public sign.

decisions.choice: the long hair that showed they belonged to God
decisions.reason: Readable explains "his consecrated head" as the hair that marked the vow.

source.text: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־הַזְּרֹ֣עַ בְּשֵׁלָה֮ מִן־הָאַיִל֒ וְֽחַלַּ֨ת מַצָּ֤ה אַחַת֙ מִן־הַסַּ֔ל וּרְקִ֥יק מַצָּ֖ה אֶחָ֑ד וְנָתַן֙ עַל־כַּפֵּ֣י הַנָּזִ֔יר אַחַ֖ר הִֽתְגַּלְּח֥וֹ אֶת־נִזְרֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And will take the priest the shoulder boiled from the ram, and cake of unleavened bread one from the basket, and wafer of unleavened bread one, and put [them] on [the] palms of the Nazirite after his shaving [of] his consecration.

en.L: And the priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake from the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and put [them] on the palms of the Nazirite after he has shaved [off] his consecration.
en.B: The priest is to take the boiled shoulder of the ram, one loaf and one wafer of bread made without yeast from the basket, and put them in the hands of the Nazirite after they have shaved off their consecrated hair.
en.R: After the Nazirite has shaved off that hair, the priest must take the boiled shoulder of the ram, with one loaf and one wafer from the basket. He must put them in the Nazirite's hands.

es.L: Y el sacerdote tomará la espaldilla cocida del carnero, y una torta sin levadura del canastillo, y una oblea sin levadura, y [las] pondrá en las palmas del nazareo después de que se haya rapado su consagración.
es.B: El sacerdote tomará la espaldilla cocida del carnero, una torta y una oblea sin levadura del canastillo, y las pondrá en las manos del nazareo, después de que se haya rapado el cabello consagrado.
es.R: Cuando el nazareo se haya rapado ese cabello, el sacerdote tiene que tomar la espaldilla cocida del carnero, con un pan y una oblea del canastillo. Tiene que ponerlos en las manos del nazareo.

fr.L: Et le prêtre prendra l’épaule bouillie du bélier, et un gâteau sans levain de la corbeille, et une galette sans levain, et [les] mettra sur les paumes du naziréen après qu’il aura rasé sa consécration.
fr.B: Le prêtre prendra l’épaule cuite du bélier, un gâteau et une galette sans levain dans la corbeille, et les mettra dans les mains du naziréen, une fois que celui-ci aura rasé ses cheveux consacrés.
fr.R: Quand le naziréen a rasé ses cheveux, le prêtre doit prendre l’épaule cuite du bélier, avec un pain et une galette de la corbeille. Il doit les mettre dans les mains du naziréen.

sw.L: Na kuhani atachukua bega lililochemshwa la kondoo dume, na mkate mmoja usiotiwa chachu kutoka katika kikapu, na mkate mmoja mwembamba usiotiwa chachu, na kuviweka viganjani mwa Mnadhiri baada ya kunyoa wakfu wake.
sw.B: Kuhani atachukua bega lililochemshwa la kondoo dume, mkate mmoja na mkate mmoja mwembamba usiotiwa chachu kutoka katika kikapu, na kuviweka mikononi mwa Mnadhiri baada ya yeye kunyoa nywele zake zilizowekwa wakfu.
sw.R: Mnadhiri akishanyoa nywele hizo, lazima kuhani achukue bega lililochemshwa la kondoo dume, pamoja na mkate mmoja na mkate mmoja mwembamba kutoka katika kikapu. Lazima aviweke mikononi mwa Mnadhiri.

decisions.choice: shoulder: the foreleg of the animal
decisions.reason: The word means arm, and of an animal the foreleg or shoulder. It is a portion for the priest in addition to the breast and thigh of verse 20; Deuteronomy 18:3 also names the shoulder among the priest's dues.

decisions.choice: boiled: cooked for the meal
decisions.reason: The meat of a peace offering was boiled for eating at the sanctuary (1 Samuel 2:13-15). The priest's portion here is taken from the cooked meat.

decisions.choice: put on the palms: the worshiper holds the gift
decisions.reason: As at the ordination of the priests (Exodus 29:24; Leviticus 8:27), the portions are placed in the worshiper's hands before they are waved before the LORD.

decisions.choice: consecrated hair
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says he has shaved "his consecration"; Balanced says what was shaved, the hair that marked it.

source.text: וְהֵנִיף֩ אוֹתָ֨ם הַכֹּהֵ֥ן׀תְּנוּפָה֮ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ קֹ֤דֶשׁ הוּא֙ לַכֹּהֵ֔ן עַ֚ל חֲזֵ֣ה הַתְּנוּפָ֔ה וְעַ֖ל שׁ֣וֹק הַתְּרוּמָ֑ה וְאַחַ֛ר יִשְׁתֶּ֥ה הַנָּזִ֖יר יָֽיִן׃

records.literal_gloss: And will wave them the priest [as a] wave offering before Yahweh; holy [is] it for the priest, with [the] breast of the wave offering and with [the] thigh of the contribution; and after [that] may drink the Nazirite wine.

en.L: And the priest shall wave them as a wave offering before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; it [is] holy for the priest, together with the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution; and after that the Nazirite may drink wine.
en.B: The priest is to wave them before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as a wave offering. They are holy and belong to the priest, together with the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution. After that, the Nazirite may drink wine.
en.R: The priest must lift them up and wave them before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. These pieces are holy, and they belong to the priest, along with the breast that was waved and the thigh that was set apart. After that, the Nazirite may drink wine again.

es.L: Y el sacerdote los mecerá como ofrenda mecida delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; [es] cosa santa para el sacerdote, junto con el pecho de la ofrenda mecida y el muslo de la ofrenda alzada; y después el nazareo podrá beber vino.
es.B: El sacerdote los mecerá delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} como ofrenda mecida. Son cosas santas que pertenecen al sacerdote, junto con el pecho de la ofrenda mecida y el muslo de la contribución. Después de esto, el nazareo podrá beber vino.
es.R: El sacerdote tiene que alzarlos y mecerlos delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Estas porciones son santas y pertenecen al sacerdote, junto con el pecho que fue mecido y el muslo que fue apartado. Después de esto, el nazareo puede volver a beber vino.

fr.L: Et le prêtre les balancera en offrande balancée devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; c’[est] une chose sainte pour le prêtre, avec la poitrine de l’offrande balancée et la cuisse de l’offrande élevée ; et après cela, le naziréen pourra boire du vin.
fr.B: Le prêtre les balancera devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en offrande balancée. Ce sont des choses saintes qui reviennent au prêtre, avec la poitrine de l’offrande balancée et la cuisse de la contribution. Après cela, le naziréen pourra boire du vin.
fr.R: Le prêtre doit les élever et les balancer devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Ces morceaux sont saints et ils reviennent au prêtre, avec la poitrine qui a été balancée et la cuisse qui a été mise à part. Après cela, le naziréen peut de nouveau boire du vin.

sw.L: Na kuhani atavitikisa kuwa sadaka ya kutikiswa mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; [ni] kitu kitakatifu kwa kuhani, pamoja na kidari cha sadaka ya kutikiswa na paja la sadaka ya kuinuliwa; na baadaye Mnadhiri anaweza kunywa divai.
sw.B: Kuhani atavitikisa mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuwa sadaka ya kutikiswa. Ni vitu vitakatifu, navyo ni vya kuhani, pamoja na kidari cha sadaka ya kutikiswa na paja la mchango. Baada ya hapo, Mnadhiri anaweza kunywa divai.
sw.R: Lazima kuhani aviinue na kuvitikisa mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Vipande hivi ni vitakatifu, navyo ni vya kuhani, pamoja na kidari kilichotikiswa na paja lililotengwa. Baada ya hapo, Mnadhiri anaweza kunywa divai tena.

decisions.choice: wave offering: a portion lifted up before the LORD
decisions.reason: The portions were held up and moved before the LORD, marking them as given to him, and then they went to the priest (Leviticus 7:30-34; 8:27-29).

decisions.choice: the thigh of the contribution: the portion set apart for the priest
decisions.reason: The word for contribution means something lifted off or set aside from a larger whole. From every peace offering the priest received the breast and the right thigh (Leviticus 7:32-34); here he receives the boiled shoulder as well.

decisions.choice: after that the Nazirite may drink wine: the vow is over
decisions.reason: The rules of verses 3-4 end with the offering. The Nazirite returns to ordinary life.

decisions.reason: Readable adds "again" because the Nazirite drank wine before the vow.

en.B: This is the instruction for the Nazirite who makes a vow, for the offering they owe {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for their separation, besides anything more they can afford. They must do just what they promised in their vow, following the instruction for their separation.'"
en.R: These are the rules for a Nazirite and for the offering they must bring to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They may give more if they are able. But they must do everything they promised, just as the rules for Nazirites say.'"

es.L: Esta [es] la ley del nazareo que hace voto: su ofrenda {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} por su separación, además de lo que alcance su mano; conforme al voto que hizo, así hará, según la ley de su separación”».
es.B: Estas son las instrucciones para el nazareo que hace un voto, y para la ofrenda que debe {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} por su separación, además de lo que pueda dar según sus medios. Hará exactamente lo que prometió en su voto, siguiendo las instrucciones para su separación”».
es.R: Estas son las normas para el nazareo y para la ofrenda que tiene que traer {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Puede dar más si tiene con qué. Pero tiene que hacer todo lo que prometió, tal como dicen las normas para los nazareos”».

fr.B: Telles sont les instructions pour le naziréen qui fait un vœu, et pour l’offrande qu’il doit {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} pour sa séparation, en plus de ce qu’il a les moyens de donner. Il fera exactement ce qu’il a promis par son vœu, en suivant les instructions pour sa séparation.” »
fr.R: Voilà les règles pour le naziréen et pour l’offrande qu’il doit apporter {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Il peut donner davantage s’il en a les moyens. Mais il doit faire tout ce qu’il a promis, comme le disent les règles pour les naziréens.” »

sw.R: Hizi ndizo taratibu za Mnadhiri na za sadaka anayopaswa kumletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Anaweza kutoa zaidi akiweza. Lakini lazima afanye yote aliyoahidi, kama taratibu za Wanadhiri zinavyosema.'"

decisions.choice: what his hand can reach: what he can afford
decisions.reason: The same expression is used of what a person can afford in Leviticus 5:7; 14:21-22 and 27:8. The offerings of verses 14-15 are the least a Nazirite must bring; one who can afford more may add to them.

decisions.choice: according to the mouth of his vow: exactly as the vow was spoken
decisions.reason: "Mouth" here means the words spoken. If a Nazirite has promised more than the law requires, that promise must be kept as well (Numbers 30:3).

decisions.choice: on the law of his separation: according to the law
alternatives: in addition to the law of his separation
decisions.reason: The small word can mean "according to" or "in addition to". It is read here as "according to": the Nazirite keeps the vow by following this law. Read the other way, it means that whatever more was vowed is added on top of what the law requires, which the first half of the verse already says.

decisions.choice: may he bless you: a wish spoken as a prayer
decisions.reason: The verbs are in the form for a wish or request. The "you" is singular through all three lines: Israel is addressed as one people, and each person in it.

decisions.choice: keep: guard, watch over, protect
decisions.reason: The verb means to keep watch and protect from harm, as a guard does. Psalm 121:7-8 uses it of the LORD keeping his people from all evil.

decisions.choice: three lines, each naming the LORD
decisions.reason: Each line names the LORD, and each is longer than the one before: three Hebrew words, then five, then seven. A form of this blessing was found engraved on two small silver scrolls in a tomb at Ketef Hinnom in Jerusalem, from about the end of the seventh century BC.

decisions.choice: do good to you / keep you safe
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what blessing and keeping mean.

decisions.choice: "te bendiga" + "te custodie" (L), "vele por ti" (B), "te cuide de todo peligro" (R); singular "tú" through the three lines, with no plural_you span
decisions.reason: The blessing is drafted afresh from the Hebrew, keeping its three lines, each naming the LORD. "Keep" is the verb of a guard who protects from harm (m2), so the lines say "custodiar", "velar por" and "cuidar". The Hebrew "you" is singular, Israel as one people and each person in it (m1), so the Spanish is "tú" although the priests address the whole people.

decisions.choice: "te bénisse" + "qu'il te protège" (L), "veille sur toi" (B), "te mette à l'abri" (R); "tu" ("te", "toi") through the three lines
decisions.reason: The blessing is drafted afresh from the Hebrew, keeping its three lines, each naming the LORD. "Keep" is the verb of a guard who protects from harm (m2), so the lines say "protéger" and "veiller sur" rather than the traditional "garder". The Hebrew "you" is singular: Israel as one people and each person in it (m1), so French says "tu" though the priests speak to a crowd.

decisions.choice: "akubariki" + "akuhifadhi" (L), "kukuchunga" (B), "kukuweka salama" (R); singular "u-/ku-" through the three lines
decisions.reason: The blessing is drafted afresh from the Hebrew, keeping its three lines, each naming the LORD. "Keep" means guarding from harm (m2): "kuhifadhi" (keep safe) at Literal and "kuchunga" (watch over, as a shepherd) at Balanced. The Hebrew "you" is singular (m1), so the verbs take the singular object "-ku-".

decisions.choice: lift up his face toward you: turn to you with attention and favor
decisions.reason: To lift up the face toward someone is to look at them and pay them heed. The opposite is for God to hide his face, leaving his people alone in trouble (Deuteronomy 31:17-18).

decisions.choice: peace: whole well-being
decisions.reason: The word means wholeness and well-being: safety, health, plenty, and right relations with God and others, not only the absence of war.

decisions.choice: set: give and establish
decisions.reason: The verb is the ordinary word for put or place, the same verb as "put my name" in verse 27. The LORD is asked to make peace the settled state of his people.

decisions.choice: set peace for you
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the verb "set" so that it matches "set my name" in verse 27. Balanced says "grant" and Readable "give".

decisions.choice: turn toward you and care for you
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of the lifted face.

decisions.choice: "qu'il pose sur toi la paix", matching "ils poseront mon nom" in verse 27
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for putting the LORD's name on the people in verse 27 (m3). Literal uses "poser" in both verses to keep the link; Balanced says "accorder" and Readable "donner", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "akuwekee amani", matching "wataliweka jina langu" in verse 27
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for putting the LORD's name on the people in verse 27 (m3). Literal uses "kuweka" in both verses; Balanced says "kujalia" (grant) and Readable "kupa" (give).

decisions.choice: put my name on them: mark them as belonging to the LORD
decisions.reason: Speaking the LORD's name over the people three times claims them as his. To be called by the LORD's name is to belong to him (Deuteronomy 28:10; 2 Chronicles 7:14).

decisions.choice: and I will bless them: the blessing comes from God himself
decisions.reason: The pronoun "I" is written out, which Hebrew does for emphasis. The priests speak the words, but it is the LORD who gives the blessing.

decisions.choice: I myself
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced add "myself" to show the emphatic "I"; Readable says "I will be the one".
